question: In food processing, which miscellaneous constituent obtained from the maize plant is mixed with water or juice and boiled to form fillings and give products a glossy semi-clear finish
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cornstarch**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cornstarch**, derived from the maize plant, is commonly used in food processing.
 
• When **mixed with water or juice and heated, it forms a thick, glossy, and semi-clear gel-like consistency.**
 
• **This property makes it ideal for fillings, sauces, gravies,**
 
• It provide a shiny finish to food products such as pies and desserts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Acacia**:

 
 
• Acacia **refers to a genus of shrubs and trees,** but in the context of substances, it often refers to *gum arabic*.
 
• It is a **natural gum made of hardened sap from various Acacia tree species**.
 
• It is commonly used as a thickening agent, emulsifier, or stabilizer in food products, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.
 
 
 
• **Gelatin**:
 
 
• Gelatin is a **protein obtained by boiling the skin, tendons, ligaments, or bones of animals, often cows or pigs**.
 
• It is commonly used in food products like jelly, marshmallows, and gummy candies, as well as in pharmaceuticals and cosmetics.
 
• Gelatin is** known for its gelling and thickening properties.**
 
 
 
• **Algin**:
 
 
• Algin, **or alginate, is a natural polysaccharide extracted from brown seaweed**.
 
• It is widely used in the food industry as a thickening, gelling, or stabilizing agent.
 
• Alginates** also have applications in pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and even dentistry.**
